records.caption:
Tired of bare walls? Your rental deserves a garden you can peel and stick

Stuck in a rental with walls that feel cold and lifeless, and painting isn't an option? This vibrant hummingbird and poppy wallpaper peels on and off without damage, turning one plain wall into a sunlit garden in minutes. Picture your room glowing with butterflies and bright blooms every time you walk in 🌸

• Red poppies, pink and yellow wildflowers, hummingbirds and butterflies on a soft cream background
• 17.7 x 118 in (45 x 300 cm) panels
• Peel-and-stick: wipe the wall, peel, smooth with the included scraper

Link in the first comment. $16.99 on Etsy.

records.caption:
Weak, dribbly shower ruining your mornings?

A weak trickle of water makes every shower feel half-finished and leaves shampoo stuck in your hair. This shower head is built for low-pressure bathrooms, delivering a stronger, fuller spray, and it swaps onto a standard hose with no tools, so it works for renters too. Picture stepping into a shower that actually rinses you clean and wakes you up. 🚿

• 3 spray modes (rain, spray and hybrid) with a one-touch stop button
• Gunmetal gray, about 25 cm (9.8 in) long with a 7.2 cm (2.8 in) head
• Fits standard shower hoses and swaps on by hand, no tools

Link in the first comment. ¥2,480 (about $16 USD).

#showerhead #bathroomupgrade #renterfriendly #homeimprovement #apartmentliving
